verdict.rationale: Ironclad's docs provide a concrete, first-party guide for embedding a Clickwrap Workflow within an iframe on a developer's own page, which directly matches the embedded-signing story—but this applies specifically to Clickwrap (click-to-agree) flows, not full e-signature/contract signing embedding, and there's no independent/hands-on confirmation of the embed working in production. missing for 10: evidence of embedding full contract e-signature (not just clickwrap) experiences, independent/hands-on verification of the embed, and any customization/theming options for the embedded UI.
